name: Codoxime
summary: Codoxime (Codossima) is an opiate analogue that is a derivative of hydrocodone, where the 6-ketone group has been replaced by carboxymethyloxime. It has primarily antitussive effects and was found to have moderate potential to cause dependence in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: It has primarily antitussive effects and was found to have moderate potential to cause dependence in animal studies.

uses.en: It was developed as a cough suppressant.
uses.zh: 它是作為止咳藥研發的。
uses.zhHans: 它是作为止咳药研发的。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. In animal studies it showed a moderate potential to cause dependence. Opioids in general cause drowsiness, nausea and constipation, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。在動物研究中，它顯示出中等程度的依賴可能性。一般來說，鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心與便秘，過量時可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。在动物研究中，它显示出中等程度的依赖可能性。一般来说，鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心与便秘，过量时可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止。

fact.en: An oxime forms when a ketone reacts with hydroxylamine. In codoxime this reaction links the ketone of hydrocodone to a carboxymethyl group.
fact.zh: 肟是酮與羥胺反應形成的結構。在 codoxime 中，這個反應把氫可酮的酮基與羧甲基連接起來。
fact.zhHans: 肟是酮与羟胺反应形成的结构。在 codoxime 中，这个反应把氢可酮的酮基与羧甲基连接起来。
